canonical_project: Cabo Verde Technology Park – Praia Campus Data Center (TechPark CV)
owner: Government of Cabo Verde / TechPark CV Agency (executed by NOSi); financed by African Development Bank (loans ~€45.5M covering phases I & II)
notes: Tier-III-equivalent data center within the 8-hectare Cabo Verde Technology Park (TechPark CV) in Praia (Santiago Island), part of a business/incubation/training campus (~€51.85M total investment). Phase-1 construction 85% complete by Sep 2022 and due end-2022; park began operations Nov 2023 and was officially inaugurated May 5, 2025, hosting 23 companies from 7 countries with 300+ staff. Solar PV designed to cut energy costs 30-40%; Microsoft, Huawei and Intel engaged; ZEET special economic zone (2.5% CIT). A second data center plus a disaster-recovery site was planned under the 2023 phase-2 €14M AfDB loan. Praia is the landing point for EllaLink, WACS, SHARE and domestic subsea cables. Capacity in MW not publicly disclosed.
